paragraphs.text: Chapter 2 is about the people around you and about you. Over the next ten pages you will say what you like to do, fix a meeting with somebody, name the days of the week, talk about your job and your working hours, and read a figure like 68.000 out loud without stopping.
Read the red band across the top of the page as a promise rather than a list. Seven skills are printed there, and by the last page you will have used every one of them.

The five photographs carry the first of those skills. Under each one sits a single verb in the infinitive — the -en form you will find in any dictionary — and the picture gives you the meaning before you look for a translation at all.
Was machen die Leute gern? Hören Sie und notieren Sie.
Exercise 1 asks you to listen for three people — Emily, Boris and Eva — and write down what each of them likes to do. Emily's line is already filled in, so you know exactly what to listen for.
